correctness.rationale: Reconstructed factorization M(a)=exp(-mu T) f^T H_a rho0, since mutation after the pulse preserves mass. Finite edge-gradient matrix B irreducible Metzler, with positive forcing u(s)(lambda_{i+1}-lambda_i) f_i>0 during positive-measure pulse; hence Df>0. Symmetric H_a preserves sign of initial D rho0; identity M'(a)=-exp(-mu T) sum_i c_i (Df)_i(DH_a rho0)_i determines strict sign. Continuum derivative solves Dirichlet parabolic PDE with nonnegative source and strong positivity; Neumann p' sign persists. Independently checked finite identity, 2-state exact formula and sign for a=.2 and b=1. Same conclusion not claimed in nonlinear susceptible-depleting epidemics.
